questions.questionText: Consider the following sequence of operations on an empty stack. push(22); push(43); pop(); push(55); push(12); s=pop(); Consider the following sequence of operations on an empty queue. enqueue(32);enqueue(27); dequeue(); enqueue(38); enqueue(12); q=dequeue(); The value of s+q is ___________
A B-tree of order (degree) 5 and of height 3 will have a minimum of ___ keys.
Construct a binary search tree by inserting 8, 6, 12, 3, 10, 9 one after another. To make the resulting tree as AVL tree which of the following is required?
options: One left rotation followed by two right rotations
One left rotation and one right rotation
The resulting tree itself is AVL

questions.questionText: In a complete 4-ary tree, every internal node has exactly 4 children or no child. The number of leaves in such a tree with 6 internal nodes is:
Select the postfix expression for the infix expression a+b-c+d*(e/f).

Assuming the hash table is initially empty, which of the following is the contents of the table when the sequence 1, 4, 9, 6 is inserted into the table using closed hashing? Note that ‘_’ denotes an empty location in the table.
Compute the time complexity of the following function: void function(int n) { int count = 0; for (int i=n/2; i<=n; i++) for (int j=1; j<=n; j = j + 2) for (int k=1; k<=n; k = k * 2) count++; }

questions.questionText: Suppose a disk has 400 cylinders, numbered from 0 to 399. At some time the disk arm is at cylinder 58, and there is a queue of disk access requests for cylinder 66, 349, 201, 110, 38, 84, 226, 70, 86. If Shortest-Seek Time First (SSTF) is being used for scheduling the disk access, the request for cylinder 86 is serviced after servicing ____________ number of requests.
If frame size is 4KB then a paging system with page table entry of 2 bytes can address _______ bytes of physical memory.
Calculate the internal fragmentation if page size is 4KB and process size is 103KB.
Which of the following scheduling policy is likely to improve interactiveness?
Consider the following program: Semaphore X=1, Y=0; Void A ( ) { While (1) { P(X); Print’1’; V(Y); } } Void B ( ) { While (1) { P(Y); P(X); Print’0’; V(X); } } The possible output of the program:
options: Any number of 0’s followed by any number of 1’s.
Any number of 1’s followed by any number of 0’s.

Ensure that the ready queue is always of the same size.

the speed of CPU is increased
